canonical_name: DRAIN TRANSITION FOUNDATION READINESS & COMPLETION-TO-FRAGMENT CONTRACT

baseline_chain.note: Chain increment authorized only on formal closure of P0 (this draft leaves 15/15 invariato).

pm_open_questions_b2b2q.question: Drain execution ID generation: server-generated on START_DRAIN acceptance OR deterministically derived from trusted internal command?
pm_open_questions_b2b2q.evidence: PM §8 verbatim: client-provided authoritative execution ID is FORBIDDEN. Two viable server-authoritative patterns exist (uuid4 vs sha256-derived deterministic).
options: A. Server-generated at START_DRAIN acceptance: drn-<uuid4[:16]>. Returned in TransitionResult. Client subsequent commands reference the emitted ID.
B. Deterministically derived server-side: sha256(expedition_id · source · target · mark_id · application_id · phase_id · server_nonce)[0:20]. Replay-safe.
pm_open_questions_b2b2q.agent_recommendation: Option A (uuid4-based) for dedup simplicity + audit clarity + no derivation-time coupling to Mark/phase state.
pm_open_questions_b2b2q.security_impact: Both options prevent client-authoritative forgery. Option A relies on server RNG; Option B is deterministic and audit-friendly for post-mortem replay.
pm_open_questions_b2b2q.test_impact: Test cases must assert non-client-provided execution ID enforcement; Option B additionally requires collision-free assertions across boundary scenarios.

pm_open_questions_b2b2q.question: START_DRAIN trusted event source: same trusted_context path used by APPLY_MARK/GAIN_FRAGMENT (test-user-bounded) OR extended trusted-command source?
pm_open_questions_b2b2q.evidence: RT2-B-2B-1 uses trusted_context with feature_enabled+test_user_verified+db_allowlisted. Drain introduces additional revalidation surface.
options: A. Reuse existing trusted_context signature (no schema change).
B. Extend trusted_context with drain-specific fields (e.g., phase_id required, expected_state_version override policy).
pm_open_questions_b2b2q.agent_recommendation: Option A (reuse) for consistency; drain-specific fields can be part of ClassStateEvent payload rather than trusted_context.
pm_open_questions_b2b2q.security_impact: Reuse keeps single boundary surface; extension adds attack surface.
pm_open_questions_b2b2q.test_impact: Reuse: existing 4 gating tests suffice + Drain-specific. Extension: additional gate tests.

pm_open_questions_b2b2q.question: Mark binding and refresh behavior: refresh preserves Drain OR refresh invalidates Drain when application_id semantics change?
pm_open_questions_b2b2q.evidence: PM §9: refresh keeping application_id preserves Drain; new application_id (post-expiration reapplication) invalidates. Ambiguity: is 'refresh' defined as strict application_id invariance?
options: A. Refresh = same mark_id AND same application_id AND expires_at extended. Drain preserved.
B. Refresh = same mark_id, application_id may bump (semantic refresh). Drain invalidated.
pm_open_questions_b2b2q.agent_recommendation: Option A. Strict application_id invariance keeps binding contract sharp and matches RT2-B-2B-1 REFRESH_MARK semantics.
pm_open_questions_b2b2q.security_impact: Option A prevents accidental Drain preservation under semantic reapplication.
pm_open_questions_b2b2q.test_impact: Refresh-preserves-Drain test + reapplication-invalidates-Drain test required (test matrix §41 cases).

pm_open_questions_b2b2q.question: Mark validation at completion: full revalidation OR reduced (only mark_id+application_id equality + not expired)?
options: A. Full revalidation: source · target · mark_id · application_id · not-expired · not-cancelled.
B. Reduced revalidation: mark_id+application_id + not-expired (skip source/target if stored in DrainDoc).
pm_open_questions_b2b2q.agent_recommendation: Option A (full). Defense-in-depth; DrainDoc could be tampered indirectly via state-doc corruption in future; independent revalidation adds redundancy.

pm_open_questions_b2b2q.question: Fragment amount per accepted completion: fixed constant (1) OR variable via payload?
pm_open_questions_b2b2q.evidence: PM §10: Fragment source = accepted Drain completion only, cap 5, overflow discarded. Amount not yet ratified.
options: A. Fixed constant 1 per completion.
B. Variable amount (1..N) from trusted server-derived payload.
C. Variable amount via feature flag param (out of P0 scope).
pm_open_questions_b2b2q.agent_recommendation: Option A (fixed 1) for determinism, simpler test contract, RT1 baseline alignment.
pm_open_questions_b2b2q.security_impact: Option A minimizes payload attack surface.
pm_open_questions_b2b2q.test_impact: Overflow tests simpler with fixed amount.

pm_open_questions_b2b2q.question: Fragment outcome when already at cap: Drain still completes OR Drain rejected?
pm_open_questions_b2b2q.evidence: PM §10 verbatim: 'Drain completion may still complete (NOT annullata perché risorsa al cap). Fragment granted = 0. overflow_discarded recorded diagnostically.'
options: A. Drain completes with fragment_granted=0, overflow_discarded=1 (or requested amount) — verbatim PM §10.
B. Drain rejected with FRAGMENT_CAP_REACHED (against PM §10 verbatim).
pm_open_questions_b2b2q.state_impact: fragment_count unchanged; overflow_discarded counter incremented in receipt.

pm_open_questions_b2b2q.question: completion-to-Fragment atomic result contract: single receipt vs multiple receipts per completion event?
pm_open_questions_b2b2q.evidence: PM §16 defines completion receipt content. Segment opening and overflow discard could be either embedded fields OR separate receipts.
options: A. Single completion receipt with embedded fields (fragment_gain_applied, fragment_overflow_discarded, resource_segment_id).
B. Multiple receipts: COMPLETE_DRAIN + DISCARD_FRAGMENT_OVERFLOW (if any) + OPEN_RESOURCE_SEGMENT (if any).
pm_open_questions_b2b2q.agent_recommendation: Option A. Reduces ordinary capacity consumption; keeps atomic-batch shape clear; receipt content still contains diagnostic fields for audit.
pm_open_questions_b2b2q.state_impact: processed_event_keys usage per completion = 1 slot instead of up to 3.
pm_open_questions_b2b2q.test_impact: Receipt content assertions richer; capacity math simpler.

pm_open_questions_b2b2q.question: cancellation reason-code extensions: baseline = 8 verbatim reuse, or extend with new codes?
pm_open_questions_b2b2q.evidence: PM §7 verbatim: reuse 8 codes; extensions require real case + non-overlap + PM adjudication; NO auto-ratify.
options: A. NO extensions (baseline recommended).
B. Add new code(s) supported by real case found in discovery.
pm_open_questions_b2b2q.agent_recommendation: Option A (NO extensions). 8 codes cover all discovered scenarios in this P0.
pm_open_questions_b2b2q.test_impact: Cancellation cases mapped to existing 8 codes.

pm_open_questions_b2b2q.question: completion/rejection result-code set: minimal (reuse RT2-B-2B-1 codes) OR add DRAIN_ALREADY_IN_PROGRESS_FOR_PAIR + DRAIN_ALREADY_COMPLETED + DRAIN_CANCELLED?
pm_open_questions_b2b2q.evidence: Existing TransitionResultCode covers general codes. Drain state machine requires 3 additional distinguishing codes.
options: A. Add 3 new codes: DRAIN_ALREADY_IN_PROGRESS_FOR_PAIR, DRAIN_ALREADY_COMPLETED, DRAIN_CANCELLED.
B. Reuse STATE_VERSION_CONFLICT / DEDUPLICATED_NO_OP with reason_code disambiguation.
pm_open_questions_b2b2q.agent_recommendation: Option A. Clarity for audit + test assertions.

pm_open_questions_b2b2q.question: completion-vs-cancellation race precedence: first-committed-wins OR completion-precedence?
pm_open_questions_b2b2q.evidence: PM §14 baseline: completion first → later cancellation returns ALREADY_COMPLETED; cancellation first → later completion returns DRAIN_CANCELLED.
options: A. First-committed-wins (verbatim baseline).
B. Completion has semantic precedence (rare edge).
pm_open_questions_b2b2q.agent_recommendation: Option A (verbatim baseline). Single writer + CAS naturally enforces first-committed-wins.
pm_open_questions_b2b2q.state_impact: DrainDoc.runtime_status becomes sticky on first terminal write.
pm_open_questions_b2b2q.test_impact: Race tests deterministic under Option A.

pm_open_questions_b2b2q.question: completion-vs-phase-end precedence: phase_end terminalization cancels in-flight drains OR rejects them at completion time?
pm_open_questions_b2b2q.evidence: PM §14 baseline: terminalization/phase-end committed first → later completion rejected. In-flight drains: auto-cancel via reserved-capacity batch OR mark them EXPIRED at next access?
options: A. Bulk auto-cancel in-flight Drains during PHASE_END event batch (reserved capacity usage).
B. Leave Drains as IN_PROGRESS and reject subsequent completion attempts (lazy expiration analog).
pm_open_questions_b2b2q.agent_recommendation: Option A. Matches auto_close_on_phase_end semantics for resource_segment; keeps state consistent post-phase-end.
pm_open_questions_b2b2q.state_impact: Reserved receipt capacity consumption per phase-end.

pm_open_questions_b2b2q.question: lease and retry boundary: retry max 3 (invariato) OR reduced for Drain due to atomic batch complexity?
pm_open_questions_b2b2q.evidence: PM §13 baseline: automatic retries ≤ 3. Drain atomic batch has more validation steps than Mark/Fragment.
options: A. Retry max 3 (invariato).
B. Retry max 2 for Drain completion (higher validation cost per retry).
pm_open_questions_b2b2q.agent_recommendation: Option A (invariato). Consistency with RT2-B-2B-1 contract; validation cost measured in real-Mongo tests.

pm_open_questions_b2b2q.question: Drain feature-flag composition: separate flag AND-composed OR nested inside cdv_class_transitions_enabled?
pm_open_questions_b2b2q.evidence: PM §6 baseline: separate flag cdv_drain_transitions_enabled AND-composed with existing flags (quintuple-gate).
options: A. Separate flag AND-composed (verbatim baseline).
B. Nested inside cdv_class_transitions_enabled (single flag, wider blast radius).
pm_open_questions_b2b2q.agent_recommendation: Option A (verbatim baseline). Independent kill-switch for Drain runtime risks.

pm_open_questions_b2b2q.question: receipt classification: DRAIN_AUTO_CANCELLED_ON_MARK_EXPIRATION category = ORDINARY or RESERVED? single completion receipt or split?
pm_open_questions_b2b2q.evidence: PM §17 baseline: START/COMPLETE/CANCEL = ORDINARY; automatic phase_end/terminalization cancel = may use RESERVED batch. Mark expiration cascade not explicitly ratified.
options: A. DRAIN_AUTO_CANCELLED_ON_MARK_EXPIRATION = ORDINARY (individual event, not lifecycle).
B. DRAIN_AUTO_CANCELLED_ON_MARK_EXPIRATION = RESERVED (attach to LAZY_MARK_EXPIRATION event batch).
pm_open_questions_b2b2q.agent_recommendation: Option A. Mark expiration cascade is per-Mark, not global lifecycle; keeps reserved capacity for phase-end/terminalization.

pm_open_questions_b2b2q.question: audit contract: 10 event ids sufficient OR add cdv_drain_bulk_cancelled for phase_end cascade?
pm_open_questions_b2b2q.evidence: PM §18 baseline: 10 event ids listed. Phase_end cascade may emit N cancellations; single aggregate audit vs per-drain event?
options: A. 10 event ids as listed (verbatim baseline); phase_end cascade emits N × cdv_drain_cancelled.
B. Add cdv_drain_bulk_cancelled aggregate event for phase_end cascade (11 total).
pm_open_questions_b2b2q.agent_recommendation: Option A (verbatim baseline). Individual cancellation events preserve traceability.
pm_open_questions_b2b2q.test_impact: Individual event assertions on cascade tests.

pm_open_questions_b2b2q.question: first code-gate exact scope: full 3 events + atomic Fragment batch in single code gate OR sliced into 2 sub-gates?
pm_open_questions_b2b2q.evidence: RT2-B-2B-1 single code gate delivered 37/37 FakeStore + 30/30 real-Mongo. Drain gate has more state complexity.
options: A. Single code gate: START/COMPLETE/CANCEL + atomic Fragment batch + FakeStore tests. Real-Mongo V1 subordinate (analog to RT2-B-2B-1).
B. Two sub-gates: (1) START/CANCEL scaffolding; (2) COMPLETE + atomic Fragment batch.
pm_open_questions_b2b2q.agent_recommendation: Option A (single gate, mirror RT2-B-2B-1). Coherence + reduced governance overhead.
pm_open_questions_b2b2q.state_impact: One state_version schema uplift for DrainDoc field additions.
pm_open_questions_b2b2q.security_impact: Larger single-gate blast radius; mitigated by feature flag OFF.
